newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine banks' resources up 51.3 pct by end-96.
newsitem.headline: Philippine banks' resources up 51.3 pct by end-96.

text.p: Overall resources of Philippine commercial banks rose by 51.3 percent by the end of last year to reach 1.925 trillion pesos from 1.272 trillion pesos posted a year ago, the Central Bank said on Monday.

Total deposits of the 49 commercial banks grew by 39.6 percent to 1.140 trillion pesos against 817.1 billion pesos by the end of 1995, while bills payable increased to 284.4 billion pesos from 149.4 billion pesos.
The total loan portfolio surged 60.9 percent to 1.206 trillion pesos from 750.1 billion pesos.
The Central Bank said the industry's past due ratio receded to 2.8 percent in December from 3.2 percent in the previous quarter.
"The industry's stability was also reflected by its risk assets ratio at 16.6 percent for the month, which is comfortably higher than the 10.0 percent statutory requirement," it added.
